summary: This room is the palace's own operating-infrastructure neighborhood — STIGMERGY, SUBSTRATE, ROSETTA, Project Stewardship System, Swarm Weave, Trickster, and the SDKM/Skills-Are-Enchantable-Pages self-description family — and it is already densely and mostly-correctly cross-linked; several of the biggest entries (STIGMERGY, SUBSTRATE, Trickster, Symbiotic Skills) had nothing missing on a close read. The real yield was in the meta/translation layer, where pages that describe the palace to itself (ROSETTA, Self-Describing Knowledge Module, Skills Are Enchantable Pages) cite each other's worked examples by name in prose without ever wiring the link — a pattern worth noting for future weaves: self-description entries are exactly the ones most likely to name a sibling as evidence and then forget to link it, because the citation feels like it's "just an example" rather than a relationship. The most interesting single find is that SDKM's own Open Questions section already flags an unresolved disagreement with ROSETTA's translation table and calls it "prior to" the page's whole reason for existing — that's a contradiction sitting in plain sight, unwired, on a pair that already carries a different (correct) link type. One newcomer link landed: Swarm Weave names `assume multi-agent` by title as its own evidence for the oblique-lens finding, giving that under-reached entry a genuine, specific inbound path rather than a generous one.
